logline: 1482년 광인절의 파리에서 곱추 종지기 콰지모도가 광인 교황으로 뽑히고, 집시 무희 에스메랄다에게 물 한 모금의 은혜를 입은 뒤, 죄를 뒤집어쓴 그녀를 처형대 앞에서 밧줄을 타고 내려와 성당으로 안아 들여 지키다가, 부랑자들의 습격에 돌을 굴려 맞서는 사이 검은 옷의 부주교가 그녀를 배로 빼돌려 방이 비어 있다
destination: 소설 노트르담 드 파리에서 만날 수 있습니다
setting: 1482년 파리 — 노트르담 성당 앞 광장과 형틀, 종탑 안과 탑 꼭대기, 감옥, 성당의 큰 문과 지붕 밑 작은 방, 밤의 센 강
anchor: a hunchbacked bell-ringer in a dull yellow tunic and a gipsy dancer with long black hair before the grey west front of Notre-Dame
palette: ash grey, dark blue, off-white, dull yellow, dark brown
withheld: 교수대에서 벌어진 일, 탑 위의 웃음이 맞은 결말과 두 해 뒤 몽포콩의 해골

beats.motion: the captain's raised hand and the girl are the two things that move, and the hunchback holds still: at the start the hand is raised high in a command and the girl is pulling away with one hand against the wall; over the first three seconds the raised hand comes slowly down and forward, pointing at the crouched hunchback, the captain's cloak shifting at his shoulder, and the girl draws slowly one step further along the wall away from the hunchback, her black hair swinging and her face staying turned to the captain; in the last two seconds the pointing hand holds and the girl holds against the wall; the hunchback stays crouched with his hands open before him and his face turned to the captain, nothing in him moving; the lantern on the house wall keeps its steady dull yellow light; the leaning half-timbered houses and the cobbles hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift

beats.beat: 형틀에 묶인 종지기에게 물을 준 이는 에스메랄다뿐이다

beats.beat: 풀려난 종지기가 성당의 큰 종을 울린다

beats.beat: 검은 옷의 부주교가 성당 탑에서 광장의 무희를 내려다본다

beats.beat: 부주교가 근위대장을 찌른 죄가 무희에게 씌워져 그녀가 옥에 갇힌다
beats.visual: thin grey light from the one small barred window high in the ash grey stone wall of the prison cell: the slender girl of sixteen with the long black hair hanging tangled and the brown-skinned oval face gone pale, in the off-white blouse torn at one shoulder and the full dark blue skirt with the dull yellow sash, is the one sitting at frame centre on the straw with her back against the stone wall and her knees drawn up under the skirt, both her arms wrapped round her knees and her chin resting on them, her big dark eyes open and fixed on the floor; a heavy iron ring is set in the wall above her head with a short chain hanging from it to the straw; the thin band of grey light from the window lies across the straw and up the wall at frame right; the rest of the cell is in shadow; the straw is dirty and flattened; there is exactly one person in the cell

beats.beat: 처형대로 끌려가는 에스메랄다를 종지기가 밧줄을 타고 내려와 안는다
beats.visual: flat grey winter light over the square before the cathedral: a thick rope hangs down the pale grey stone of the cathedral's west front from the gallery of stone kings high up at frame centre, and the short thick-set man of twenty with the great rounded hump of his own crooked back swelling under the tunic cloth, his plain young face clean-shaven, in the rough dull yellow tunic, is the one clinging to the rope a man's height above the cobbles, climbing, with one big hand gripping the rope above his head and his other arm clasped round the waist of the girl, his bare feet against the stone; the slender girl of sixteen with the long black hair falling loose, in the off-white blouse and the dark blue skirt, is the one held against his side with both her arms round his thick neck and her face pressed to his shoulder, her bare feet swinging clear of the ground; the wooden scaffold with its steps stands on the cobbles at frame right with the medieval guards in plain steel caps and brown leather jerkins with pikes round its foot all turned toward the rope with their faces up; there are exactly two people on the rope

beats.beat: 피난처를 외치며 종지기가 그녀를 성당 안으로 데려간다
beats.visual: flat grey winter light on the wide stone steps before the great west doors of the cathedral: the short thick-set man of twenty with the great hump on his back and the bristling dark brown hair, in the rough dull yellow tunic, is the one standing at frame centre on the top step with his back to the camera, the girl lifted in both his thick arms and held high over his head with her dark blue skirt and her loose black hair falling down over his hump, his bare feet planted wide on the stone, his crooked face turned up to her and hidden from the camera; the slender girl of sixteen in the off-white blouse is the one held up in his arms with her face turned down to him, her bare feet in the air; the heavy oak doors bound in iron stand open before them inside the tall carved stone portal with the dark of the nave beyond; the carved figures of the portal rise on both sides to the top of the frame; the cobbles show at the bottom; there are exactly two people on the steps and the man's back is to the camera

beats.beat: 성당 지붕의 작은 방에서 종지기가 그녀에게 빵과 물을 가져다준다
beats.visual: soft grey light from the small round window of the little stone room high under the cathedral's roof: the slender girl of sixteen with the long black hair and the brown-skinned oval face, in the off-white blouse and the full dark blue skirt, is the one sitting at frame right on the bed of straw with her back against the stone wall and her legs folded under her skirt, her big dark eyes lifted to the doorway; the small white goat with the gilt horns is the one lying curled beside her in the straw with its head up; the short thick-set man of twenty with the great hump on his back and the bristling dark brown hair, in the rough dull yellow tunic, is the one standing at frame left just inside the low doorway with his head bowed and his one seen eye turned away from her, holding out at arm's length a round loaf of dark brown bread in one big hand and the clay jug of water gripped by its handle in his other big hand, both his arms stretched out toward the bed, his bare feet on the stone; the wooden bowl stands on the floor between them; the small round window shows the grey sky; there are exactly two people in the room
beats.motion: the hunchback's outstretched hands are the one thing that moves, and the girl holds still: at the start the round loaf and the jug are held out at arm's length with his head bowed and his eye turned away; over the first three seconds he bends slowly at the knees and sets the loaf and the jug down on the stone floor beside the wooden bowl, his head staying bowed and his face staying turned from her, and straightens slowly again with his big hands empty; in the last two seconds he holds just inside the doorway with his hands hanging at his sides; his bare feet do not shift; the girl on the straw keeps her eyes lifted to him and her legs folded, nothing in her moving; the white goat keeps its head up and its body curled in the straw; the loaf, the jug and the bowl hold their places on the floor; the small round window and the stone walls hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift

beats.beat: 어느 밤 부랑자 무리가 그녀를 구하러 성당으로 몰려온다

beats.beat: 그것을 공격으로 안 종지기가 위에서 돌을 굴려 맞선다

beats.beat: 그 틈에 검은 옷의 남자가 성당에서 무희를 배에 태워 빼돌린다

beats.beat: 텅 빈 방 앞에 선 종지기가 광장에서 무엇을 보게 될지 알 수 없다
